QuestInfo.name: Just Another Day at Work
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 8,393\r\nCan proceed to 'Rolling with Polys 1' quest\r\n
QuestInfo.0: Go see #bManager Karl#k at the #b#m220020300##k in Ludibrium.
QuestInfo.1: #bManager Karl#k needs your help to prepare a report on the Roly-Polys working on Eos Tower by taking pictures with them while they work. They must be found in order. Go find #bRoly-Poly 1#k on #b#m221023100##k.
QuestInfo.2: I found Roly-Poly 1 at the 99th floor of Eos Tower working hard, so I took a picture of him with the camera that #p2040015# gave me.

0.0: Hey! Since you're here, you want to help me out?

yes.0: Good. We had 10 Roly-Poly workers working at the factory. Those guys are hard workers, but right now, they have been sent abroad to fix Eos Tower. I'm sure they're working on the tower even as we speak.
yes.1: I'm just curious as to whether they work hard even without me watching over them. That is why... can you visit those guys and take a picture of each and every one of them through the camera that I'm giving you? It will be nice to have you visit them in order.
yes.2: You have the camera I gave you, right? Go meet 10 Roly-Polies in order, take their photos, and bring back those photos along with the camera. Meet #bRoly-Poly 1#k on #b#m221023100##k.

no.0: Hmmm... You must be busy right now. I sure can use someone like you right now. If you ever have a change of heart, please let me know, okay?

npc.0: I guess you haven't met all 10 yet, huh? Go meet 10 Roly-Polies in order, take their photos, and bring back those photos along with the camera. Meet #bRoly-Poly 1#k on #b#m221023100##k.

item.0: Man, so much work. Whoa. Are you here at #b#p2040015##k's request? It looks like you've lost the camera, though. Please go back to Manager Karl and talk to him about the camera.

lost.0: Wait, d-did you lose my camera? Geez, I told you to be careful, didn't I? Well, don't worry, I have a spare one. Okay now, take this camera, go to the Eos Tower, take the photo of all the Roly-Polies in order and bring me 10 photos. First, go see #bRoly-Poly 1#k on #b#m221023100##k.
